name: open-mem
description: OpenCode memory autopilot: two-lane consolidation, local review console, shadow memory map.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix plugin install && npm --prefix console install
scripts.build: npm --prefix plugin run build && npm --prefix console run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix plugin run typecheck && npm --prefix console run typecheck && npm run typecheck:extension
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:extension && npm run test:extension && git diff --check
